intro.text: A strategist with the Second Company who advises Vathi in the talks with the Ones Above.

title.text: The talks with the Ones Above

items.text: To buy time, Tuli suggested staging a coup to remove Vathi, which would force the Ones Above to start the talks over.

appearance.text: Keeps a colourful Aviar of the same breed as Kokerlii, which can hide minds from nearby predators.
